mapper.select: SELECT TOP (#{limit}) LTRIM(RTRIM(t.[itemCode])) AS [product_code], t.[itemModel] AS [product_model], t.[itemDesc] AS [product_name], t.[itemDesc] AS [product_desc], t.[remark] AS [technical_spec], t.[productCode] AS [product_category], t.[productSubCode] AS [product_type], t.[listPrice] AS [list_price], t.[status] AS [crm_status], t.[BU] AS [business_unit], t.[productLine] AS [product_line], t.[orgId] AS [org_id], t.[createTime] AS [source_created_at], t.[updateTime] AS [source_updated_at], t.[statecode] AS [crm_state_code], t.[statuscode] AS [crm_status_code], t.[productStage] AS [product_stage], t.[endOfSaleDate] AS [end_of_sale_date], t.[endOfSupportDate] AS [end_of_support_date], t.[endOfLifeDate] AS [end_of_life_date], t.[lastRenewalDate] AS [last_renewal_date] FROM DPtech_v_product_info_single t ORDER BY t.[itemCode]
